s.d: συν-ζάω (Rec. συζ-), to live with: opposite to συναποθανεῖν, [[2-corinthians 7 3|2Co.7:3;]] of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, [[romans 6 8|Rom.6:8]], [[2-timothy 2 11|2Ti.2:11]].† (AS)
συν-ζεύγνυμι (Rec. συζ-), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 1 11|Eze.1:11, 23]] (חָבַר) * ;] to yoke to­gether: metaphorically, of union in wedlock, [[matthew 19 6|Mat.19:6]], [[mark 10 9|Mrk.10:9]].† (AS)

συν-ζητέω (Rec. συζ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: [[nehemiah 2 4|Neh.2:4]] AB1 (בָּקַשׁ pi.) * ;] 1. to search or examine together (Plat.). 2. In NT (and π., see MM, xxiii; also in MGr., see Kennedy, Sources, 155), to discuss, dispute: [[mark 1 27|Mrk.1:27 12:28]], [[luke 24 15|Luk.24:15]]; before quæst. indir., [[mark 9 10|Mrk.9:10;]] with dative of person(s), [[mark 8 11|Mrk.8:11]] [[acts 6 9|Act.6:9]]; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[mark 9 14|Mrk.9:14, 16]], [[acts 9 29|Act.9:29]]; id. before quæst. indir., [[luke 22 23|Luk.22:23.]]† (AS)
συν-ζήτηαις (Rec. συζ-), -εως, ἡ disputation: [[acts 28 29|Act.28:29]] (WH, R, txt., om.).† (AS)
συν-ζητητής (Rec. συζ-), -οῦ, ἁ (συνζητέω), a disputer, disputant: [[1-corinthians 1 20|1Co.1:20.]]† (AS)

σύν-ζυγος (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον (συνζεύγνυμι), [in Aq., [[ezekiel 23 21|Eze.23:21]] * ;] a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, [[philippians 4 3|Php.4:3]] (see ICC, Lft., in l; MM, xxiii).† (AS)
συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-, to make alive or quicken together with; metaphorically, of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, [[ephesians 2 5|Eph.2:5;]] σὺν τ. Χ., [[colossians 2 13|Col.2:13.]]† (AS)

συκάμινος, -ου, ἡ [in LXX for שִׁקְמָה (pl.) ;] the mulberry tree (Lat. morus; cf. μόρον, 1Ma.6:34 *), the sycamine: [[luke 17 6|Luk.17:6.]] (In LXX, σ. appears to represent the συκόμορος (see: συκομορέα), but St. Luke distinguishes between the two; see ICC, in l; DB, iv, 634.) † (AS)

συκῆ (contr. fr. συκέα), -ῆς, ἡ (σῦκον), [in LXX for תְּאֵן ;] a fig-tree: [[matthew 21 19|Mat.21:19-21 24:32]], [[mark 11 13|Mrk.11:13, 20-21 13:28]], [[luke 13 6|Luk.13:6-7 21:29]], [[john 1 49|Jhn.1:49, 51]], [[james 3 12|Jas.3:12]], [[revelation 6 13|Rev.6:13]].† (AS)

συκο-μορέα (Rec. -μωραία, L, -μωρέα), -ας, ἡ, more commonly (so Aq., Sm., [[psalms 78 47|Psa.78:47]], [[isaiah 9 10|Isa.9:10]]) συκόμορος (σῦκον + μόρον, the black mulberry), a fig-mulberry, a sycamore: [[luke 19 4|Luk.19:4]] (cf. συκάμινος).† (AS)
σῦκον, -ου, τό [in LXX for תְּאֵן ] a fig: [[matthew 7 16|Mat.7:16]], [[mark 11 13|Mrk.11:13]], [[luke 6 44|Luk.6:44]] [[james 3 12|Jas.3:12]].† (AS)

συκοφαντέω, -ῶ (σῦκον, φαίνω), [in LXX: [[genesis 43 18|Gen.43:18]] (גָּלַל hithpo.), [[leviticus 19 11|Lev.19:11]] (שָׁקַר pi.), [[job 35 9|Job.35:9]], [[psalms 119 122|Psa.119:122]], [[proverbs 14 31|Pro.14:31 2:16 28:3]], [[ecclesiastes 4 1|Ecc.4:1]] (עָשַׁק) ;] to act the συκοφάντης (on conjectures as to the origin of the term, see LS, see word), to accuse falsely (Aristoph., Xen., al.): [[luke 3 14|Luk.3:14]] (R, mg.) [[luke 19 8|Luk.19:8]] (RV, exact wrongfully; but cf. Hatch, Essays, 89 ff., see also Field, Notes, 56 f.; MM, xxiv).† (AS)
συλαγωγέω, -ῶ (σύλη, booty + ἄγω), to carry off as spoil, lead captive (θυγατέρα, Heliod., Aeth., 10, 35): metaphorically, [[colossians 2 8|Col.2:8.]]† (AS)
συλάω, -ῶ [in LXX: Ep. [[jeremiah 1 18|Jer.1:18]] * ;] with accusative of person(s), to strip, plunder, spoil: [[2-corinthians 11 8|2Co.11:8.]]† (AS)
to talk or converse with another, (New Testament) (ML)

συλ-λαμβάνω [in LXX for תָּפַשׂ, הָרָה, etc. ;] 1. with accusative, to bring together, collect. 2. to seize, take: with accusative of person(s), as a prisoner, [[matthew 26 55|Mat.26:55]], [[mark 14 48|Mrk.14:48]], [[luke 22 54|Luk.22:54]], [[john 18 12|Jhn.18:12]], [[acts 1 16|Act.1:16 12:3]]; pass., [[acts 23 27|Act.23:27;]] mid., in sense of act., [[acts 26 21|Act.26:21;]] σ. ἄγραν ἰχθύων, [[luke 5 9|Luk.5:9.]] 3. C. dative of person(s), to take part with, assist, succour; mid., in same sense: [[luke 5 7|Luk.5:7]], [[philippians 4 3|Php.4:3]]. 4. Of a woman, to conceive: absol., [[luke 1 24|Luk.1:24;]] before ἐν γαστρί, [[luke 1 31|Luk.1:31;]] with accusative, [[luke 1 36|Luk.1:36;]] ib. before ἐν τ. κοιλίᾳ, [[luke 2 21|Luk.2:21;]] metaphorically, of lust producing sin, [[james 1 15|Jas.1:15.]]† (AS)

συλ-λέγω [in LXX chiefly for לָקַט ;] to bring together, collect, gather up: with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 13 28|Mat.13:28-30;]] pass., [[matthew 13 40|Mat.13:40;]] with accusative, before ἀπό, [[matthew 7 16|Mat.7:16;]] id. before ἐκ, [[matthew 13 41|Mat.13:41]], [[luke 6 44|Luk.6:44]]; before εἰς, [[matthew 13 48|Mat.13:48.]]† (AS)
συλ-λογίζομαι [in LXX chiefly for חָשַׁב pi. ;] 1. to compute. 2. to reason: [[luke 20 5|Luk.20:5.]]† (AS)

συν-λυπέω (Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: [[psalms 69 20|Psa.69:20]], [[isaiah 51 19|Isa.51:19]] (נוּד) * ;] to make to grieve with (Arist.). Pass., to be moved to grief by sympathy: before ἐπί, with dative, [[mark 3 5|Mrk.3:5.]]† (AS)

συμ-βαίνω [in LXX for עָשָׂה, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;] 1. to stand with the feet together. 2. to come together, come to terms. 3. Of events, to come to pass, happen: with dative of person(s), [[mark 10 32|Mrk.10:32]], [[acts 3 10|Act.3:10 20:19]], [[1-corinthians 10 11|1Co.10:11]], [[1-peter 4 12|1Pe.4:12]], [[2-peter 2 22|2Pe.2:22]]; absol., τὰ σνμβεβηκότα, [[luke 24 14|Luk.24:14]] (cf. 1Ma.4:26); with accusative and nf., [[acts 21 35|Act.21:35.]]† (AS)

συν-βάλλω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 25 19|2Ch.25:19]] (גָּרָה hith.), [[isaiah 46 6|Isa.46:6]] (זוּל), [[jeremiah 43 3|Jer.43:3]] (סוּת hi.), Wis.5:8, al. ;] to throw together, hence, (a) of speech (before λόγους, Eur., al.), to discuss, confer (sc. λόγους): with dative of person(s), [[luke 11 53|Luk.11:53]], WH, mg., [[acts 17 18|Act.17:18;]] before πρὸς ἀλλήλους, [[acts 4 15|Act.4:15;]] (b) to reflect, consider, ponder: ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, [[luke 2 19|Luk.2:19;]] (with) to meet with, fall in with: [[acts 20 14|Act.20:14;]] in hostile sense, εἰς πόλεμον, with dative (εἰς μάχην, Polyb.), [[luke 14 31|Luk.14:31;]] (d) mid., to contribute (Polyb., al.; cf. MM, xxiv): [[acts 18 27|Act.18:27.]]† (AS)

συμ-βουλεύω [in LXX chiefly for יָעַץ ;] 1. to advise, counsel: with dative of person(s), [[john 18 14|Jhn.18:14;]] id. before inf., [[revelation 3 18|Rev.3:18.]] 2. Mid., to take counsel, consult: before ἵνα, [[matthew 26 4|Mat.26:4]] ("reciprocal middle," see M, Pr., 157); with inf., [[acts 9 23|Act.9:23.]]† (AS)

συν-βιβάζω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: [[exodus 4 12|Exo.4:12, 15]], [[leviticus 10 11|Lev.10:11]], [[judges 13 8|Jdg.13:8]], [[psalms 32 8|Psa.32:8]] (יָרָה hi.); [[exodus 18 16|Exo.18:16]], [[deuteronomy 4 9|Deu.4:9]], [[isaiah 40 13|Isa.40:13]] (יָדַע hi.), [[isaiah 40 14|Isa.40:14]] (בִּין hi.), Da TH [[daniel 9 22|Dan.9:22]] (שָׂכַל hi.) * ;] 1. to join or knit together, unite: [[ephesians 4 16|Eph.4:16]], [[colossians 2 2|Col.2:2]] (but see infr.), [[colossians 2 19|Col.2:19.]] 2. to compare, consider, conclude (Plat.): [[acts 16 10|Act.16:10.]] 3. to deduce, prove, demonstrate (Arist.): [[acts 9 22|Act.9:22.]] 4. As in LXX ("translation Greek," = ἐμβιβάζω, metaphorically), to teach, instruct: [[1-corinthians 2 16|1Co.2:16]] [[acts 19 33|Act.19:33]], R, mg. (also in Vg., [[colossians 2 2|Col.2:2]], instructi, but see supr.).† (AS)

1. to advise, counsel , Lat. consulere alicui, with dative pers. et infinitive, to advise one to do a thing, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. 2. without the infinitive, ς. τινί τι (Herdotus Historicus); ς. τι to recommend a measure, (Herdotus Historicus), attic:—;Pass., τὰ συμβουλευόμενα the advice given , (Xenophon Historicus) 3. absolute to advise, give advice , (Sophocles Tragicus); ὁ συμβουλεύων or -εύσας, an adviser , Lat. auctor sententiae, (Aristotle Philosopher) 4. Mid. to consult with a person, i. e. ask his advice , Lat. consulere aliquem, with dative, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: absolute to consult, deliberate , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

συμβούλιον, -ου, τό (σύμβουλος), [in LXX: 4Ma.17:17 א * ;] a word of the Græco-Roman period (of. Lat. consilium, and see Deiss., BS, 238) = cl. συμβουλία (Arist., Xen.), 1. counsel: σ. λαμβάνειν, [[matthew 12 14|Mat.12:14 22:15 27:7 28:12]]; διδόναι, [[mark 3 6|Mrk.3:6]] (ποιεῖν, Rec.); ποιεῖν, [[mark 15 1|Mrk.15:1]] (ἑτοιμάζειν, WH, mg.). 2. By meton., a council (4Mac, l.with א; συνέδριον, AR): [[acts 25 12|Act.25:12]] (see MM, xxiv).† (AS)
σύμβουλος, -ου, ὁ (σύν, βουλή), [in LXX for יָעַץ and cogn. forms ;] a counsellor, adviser: [[romans 11 34|Rom.11:34]] (LXX).† (AS)

Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), Simeon (so always AV; RV in [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]] only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 1. the son of Jacob ([[genesis 29 33|Gen.29:33]]): [[revelation 7 7|Rev.7:7]]. 2. An ancestor of our Lord: [[luke 3 30|Luk.3:30]] 3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]]. 4. One surnamed Niger: [[acts 13 1|Act.13:1.]] 5. The apostle Peter: [[acts 15 14|Act.15:14]], [[2-peter 1 1|2Pe.1:1]] (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).† (AS)

Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), Simeon (so always AV; RV in [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]] only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 1. the son of Jacob ([[genesis 29 33|Gen.29:33]]): [[revelation 7 7|Rev.7:7]]. 2. An ancestor of our Lord: [[luke 3 30|Luk.3:30]] 3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]]. 4. One surnamed Niger: [[acts 13 1|Act.13:1.]] 5. The apostle Peter: [[acts 15 14|Act.15:14]], [[2-peter 1 1|2Pe.1:1]] (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).† (AS)

Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), Simeon (so always AV; RV in [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]] only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 1. the son of Jacob ([[genesis 29 33|Gen.29:33]]): [[revelation 7 7|Rev.7:7]]. 2. An ancestor of our Lord: [[luke 3 30|Luk.3:30]] 3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]]. 4. One surnamed Niger: [[acts 13 1|Act.13:1.]] 5. The apostle Peter: [[acts 15 14|Act.15:14]], [[2-peter 1 1|2Pe.1:1]] (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).† (AS)

Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), Simeon (so always AV; RV in [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]] only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 1. the son of Jacob ([[genesis 29 33|Gen.29:33]]): [[revelation 7 7|Rev.7:7]]. 2. An ancestor of our Lord: [[luke 3 30|Luk.3:30]] 3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]]. 4. One surnamed Niger: [[acts 13 1|Act.13:1.]] 5. The apostle Peter: [[acts 15 14|Act.15:14]], [[2-peter 1 1|2Pe.1:1]] (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).† (AS)

Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), Simeon (so always AV; RV in [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]] only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 1. the son of Jacob ([[genesis 29 33|Gen.29:33]]): [[revelation 7 7|Rev.7:7]]. 2. An ancestor of our Lord: [[luke 3 30|Luk.3:30]] 3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 34]]. 4. One surnamed Niger: [[acts 13 1|Act.13:1.]] 5. The apostle Peter: [[acts 15 14|Act.15:14]], [[2-peter 1 1|2Pe.1:1]] (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).† (AS)
συν-μαθητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ a fellow-disciple: [[john 11 16|Jhn.11:16]] (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).† (AS)
συν-μαρτυρέω (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ, to bear witness with: [[romans 2 15|Rom.2:15;]] with dative, [[romans 8 16|Rom.8:16;]] before ὅτι, [[romans 9 1|Rom.9:1.]]† (AS)
συν-μερίζω (Rec. συμμ-), [in LXX: [[proverbs 29 24|Pro.29:24]] א2 (חָלַק) * ;] to distri­bute in shares. Mid., to have a share in: [[1-corinthians 9 13|1Co.9:13]] (Diod., al.).† (AS)

συν-μέτοχος (Rec. συμμ-), -ον, partaking together with; as subst., ὁ σ., a joint partaker (with dative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): with genitive of thing(s), [[ephesians 3 6|Eph.3:6;]] with genitive of person(s), [[ephesians 5 7|Eph.5:7]] (Arist.).† (AS)
συν-μιμητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ a fellow-imitator: with genitive obj., [[philippians 3 17|Php.3:17]] (see ICC, in l). Not elsewhere.† (AS)
σύμ-μορφος, -ον (σύν, μορφή), 1. absol., similar (Luc.). 2. con­formed to: with dative, [[philippians 3 21|Php.3:21;]] with genitive, [[romans 8 29|Rom.8:29]] (see B1., § 36, 11; 37, 6).† (AS)
Pass. to be conformed to , τινι (New Testament) (ML)

συν-παθέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: 4Ma.5:25 AR 4Ma.13:23 * ;] to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in: with dative of thing(s), [[hebrews 4 15|Heb.4:15;]] dative of person(s), [[hebrews 10 34|Heb.10:34]] (Arist., Plut., al.).† (AS)

συμπαθής, -ές (σύν, πάσχω) [in LXX: [[job 29 25|Job.29:25]] A (אָבֵל), 4Ma.5:25 א, 4Ma.13:23 4Mac 15:4 * ;] 1. affected by like feelings, sympathetic: [[1-peter 3 8|1Pe.3:8.]] 2. exciting sympathy (Jb, l.with; Dion. H.).† (AS)

συν-παρα-γίνομαι (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: [[psalms 83 8|Psa.83:8]] (לָוָה ni.) * ;] 1. to come up or be present together: before ἐπί, [[luke 23 48|Luk.23:48.]] 2. to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; [[2-timothy 4 16|2Ti.4:16]], Rec.).† (AS)
συν-παρα-καλέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., to be strengthened or comforted with and among: [[romans 1 12|Rom.1:12.]]† (AS)

συν-παρα-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: [[genesis 19 17|Gen.19:17]] (סָפָה ni.), [[job 1 4|Job.1:4]] (שָׁלַח ni), 3Ma.1:1 * ;] to take along with: as a companion, with accusative, [[acts 12 25|Act.12:25 15:37-38]] (on the tenses, see M, Pr., 130), [[galatians 2 1|Gal.2:1.]]† (AS)
συμ-παρα-μένω Rec, for παρα-μένω (which see), [[philippians 1 25|Php.1:25.]]† (AS)
συν-πάρειμι (Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX: Tob.12:12 ΑΒ, [[proverbs 8 27|Pro.8:27]] (?), Wis.9:10 * ;] to be present together or with: with dative of person(s), [[acts 25 24|Act.25:24.]]† (AS)

συν-πάσχω (Rec. συμπ-), [in Al.: [[1-samuel 22 8|1Ki.22:8]] * ;] 1. to suffer together or with: [[romans 8 17|Rom.8:17]], [[1-corinthians 12 28|1Co.12:28]]. 2. to sympathize with (Plat., Arist.).† (AS)
συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-) to send together with: with accusative and dative, [[2-corinthians 8 22|2Co.8:22;]] id. before μετά, with genitive, [[2-corinthians 8 18|2Co.8:18.]]† (AS)
συν-περι-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-), 1. to enclose ([[ezekiel 5 3|Eze.5:3]] (צוּר) *). 2. to embrace: with accusative of person(s), [[acts 20 10|Act.20:10.]]† (AS)

συμπόσιον, -ου, τό (συμπίνω), [in LXX: [[esther 7 7|Est.7:7]] (מִשְׁתֶּה יַיִן) [[esther 4 17|Est.4:17]], 1Ma.16:16, 2Ma.2:27, 3Ma.4:16 3Mac 5:36 3Mac 6:33; σ. οἴνου, Sir 34:31 (31:31) Sir.35:5 (32:5), Sir.49:1 * ;] 1. a drinking party 2. By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; see M, Pr., 97), in parties or companies: [[mark 6 39|Mrk.6:39.]]† (AS)

συν-πληρόω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: [[jeremiah 25 12|Jer.25:12]] (נָפַל) * ;] 1. to fill up completely (Thuc., of manning ships): of a ship filling with water, and by meton., of those on board, [[luke 8 23|Luk.8:23.]] 2. to complete, fulfil: of time (Je, l.with, and see MM, xxiv), [[luke 9 51|Luk.9:51]], [[acts 2 1|Act.2:1]] (on the "durative inf.," see M, Pr., 233).† (AS)
συν-πνίγω (Rec. συμπ-), to choke: of thronging by a crowd, [[luke 8 42|Luk.8:42.]] Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, [[matthew 13 22|Mat.13:22]], [[mark 4 7|Mrk.4:7, 19]], [[luke 8 14|Luk.8:14]].† (AS)

συν-πολίτης (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ a fellow-citizen: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opposite to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, [[ephesians 2 19|Eph.2:19]] (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).† (AS)

συν-πορεύομαι (Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;] 1. to journey together (Plat., al.): with dative of person(s), [[luke 7 11|Luk.7:11 14:25 24:15]]. 2. to come together: [[mark 10 1|Mrk.10:1]] (Plut., al.).† (AS)
1. a drinking-party, symposium , (Theognis Elegiacus), etc. 2. the room in which such parties were given, drinking-room , (Lucian) (ML)
συν-πρεσβύτερος (Rec. συμπ-), -ου, ὁ a fellow-elder: [[1-peter 5 1|1Pe.5:1]] (Eccl.).† (AS)

συμ-φέρω [in LXX: [[jeremiah 33 14|Jer.33:14]] (טוֹב), [[proverbs 19 10|Pro.19:10]] (נָאוֶה), Sir.30:19, al. ;] 1. trans. to bring together: with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 19 19|Act.19:19.]] 2. Intrans., and mostly impers., συμφέρει, it is expedient, profitable or an advantage: [[1-corinthians 6 12|1Co.6:12 10:23]], [[2-corinthians 8 10|2Co.8:10]]; with inf. (M, Pr., 210), [[matthew 19 10|Mat.19:10]], [[john 18 14|Jhn.18:14]]; with dative, before ἵνα (Bl., § 69, 5), [[matthew 5 29|Mat.5:29-30 18:6]], [[john 11 50|Jhn.11:50 16:7]]. Ptcp., ςυμφέρων, profitable: [[1-corinthians 12 7|1Co.12:7;]] pl., [[acts 20 20|Act.20:20;]] (οὐ σ. sc. ἐστιν; = οὐ συμφέρει; cf. Thuc., iii, 44, 2), [[2-corinthians 12 1|2Co.12:1;]] as subst., τὸ σ., profit, [[hebrews 12 10|Heb.12:10.]]† (AS)
σύν φημι (Rec. συμ-), to consent, confess: with dative, before ὅτι, [[romans 7 16|Rom.7:16.]]† (AS)

συμ-φυλέτης, -ου, ὁ (σύν, φυλή; cf. σύμφυλος, Aq.: [[zechariah 13 7|Zec.13:7;]] and see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.) a fellow-tribesman, fellow-countryman: [[1-thessalonians 2 14|1Th.2:14]] (see M, Th., in l, and Intr. liii). Not found elsewhere.† (AS)

σύμ-φυτος, -ον (συμφύω, to make to grow together) [in LXX: [[zechariah 11 2|Zec.11:2]] (בָּצַר), [[esther 7 7|Est.7:7]] [[esther 7 8|Est.7:8]] א2, [[amos 9 13|Amo.9:13]], 3Ma.3:22 * ;] 1. congenital, innate (Plat., al.; 3Mac, l.with). 2. grown along with, united with: τ. ὁμοιώματι τ. θανάτου αὐτσῦ (see Field, Notes, 155 f.), [[romans 6 5|Rom.6:5.]]† (AS)
συν-φύω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Wis.13:13 * ;] to cause to grow together. Pass., to grow together or with (Plat. al.): [[luke 8 7|Luk.8:7.]]† (AS)

συμ-φωνέω, -ῶ, [in LXX: [[genesis 14 3|Gen.14:3]] (H2266) [[2-samuel 12 8|2Ki.12:8]] (9) (H225 ni.), [[isaiah 7 2|Isa.7:2]] (H5117), 4Ma.14:6 * ;] prop., to agree in sound, be in harmony (Plat., Arist.). Metaphorical, (a) to agree with, agree together: [[luke 5 36|Luk.5:36;]] with dative of thing(s), [[acts 15 15|Act.15:15;]] before περί, [[matthew 18 19|Mat.18:19;]] pass., with dative of person(s), συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν, [[acts 5 9|Act.5:9;]] (b) to agree as to a price (Polyb., Diod.): with dative of person(s), genitive pret., [[matthew 20 13|Mat.20:13;]] before μετά . . . ἐκ, [[matthew 20 2|Mat.20:2.]]† (AS)
συμ-φώνησις, -εως, ἡ (συμφωνέω), concord, agreement: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[2-corinthians 6 15|2Co.6:15.]]† (AS)

συμφωνία, -ας, ἡ (σύμφωνος), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH [[daniel 3 5|Dan.3:5, 15]], TH [[daniel 3 7|Dan.3:7, 10]] (סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה) 4Ma.14:3 A * ;] 1. symphony, music: [[luke 15 25|Luk.15:25]] 2. a musical instrument (Polyb., al.; Da, ll. with; v MM, xxiv).† (AS)

σύμφωνος, -ον (ούν, φωνή), [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 7 14|Ecc.7:14]] (עֻמָּה), 4Ma.7:7 4Mac 14:7 * ;] agreeing in sound. Metaphorical, harmonious, agreeing: ἐκ συμφώνου (for exx. from π., see Deiss., BS, 255), by agreement, [[1-corinthians 7 5|1Co.7:5.]]† (AS)
συμ-ψηφίζω [in LXX: [[jeremiah 29 20|Jer.29:20]] ([[jeremiah 49 20|Jer.49:20]]) A * ;] to reckon together, count up: [[acts 19 19|Act.19:19.]]† (AS)
σύν-ψυχος (Rec. συμ-), -ον (ψυχή), of one mind: [[philippians 2 2|Php.2:2.]]† (AS)

σύν (old Att. ξύν), prep. with dative, expressing association, fellowship and inclusion. It gradually gave way to μετά, with genitive (cf. LS, see word; Bl., §41, 3), and is therefore comparatively infrequent in NT, being rare in Mat.4, Mrk.6, Jhn.3, and elsewhere (exx. [[james 1 11|Jas.1:11]], [[2-peter 1 18|2Pe.1:18]]) only in Lk (Gosp. and Ac) and Paul. With, together with: of companionship and association, [[luke 2 13|Luk.2:13]], [[john 21 3|Jhn.21:3]], [[acts 10 23|Act.10:23]], al.; εἶναι σύν τινι, [[luke 7 12|Luk.7:12]], [[acts 4 13|Act.4:13]], [[philippians 1 23|Php.1:23]], al.; of partisanship, [[acts 4 13|Act.4:13;]] οἱ σύν τινι, of attendants, companions or colleagues, [[mark 2 26|Mrk.2:26]], [[luke 5 9|Luk.5:9]], [[acts 5 17|Act.5:17]], al.; of assistance, ἡ χάρις τ. θεοῦ σὺν ἐμοί, [[1-corinthians 15 10|1Co.15:10;]] of two or more things together, almost = καί, [[luke 23 11|Luk.23:11]], [[acts 3 4|Act.3:4 10:2 14:5 23:25]], [[ephesians 3 18|Eph.3:18]]; σὺν Χριστῷ ζῆν, [[2-corinthians 13 4|2Co.13:4;]] besides (FlJ, LXX), σὺν πᾶσι τούτοις, [[luke 24 21|Luk.24:21.]] In composition: with (συνχαίρω), together (συνωδίνω), altogether (συντελέω) (AS)

συν-άγω [in LXX chiefly for אָסַף, also for קָבַץ, etc. (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 128) ;] to gather or bring together: of things, [[john 6 12|Jhn.6:12-13;]] before εἰς, [[matthew 3 12|Mat.3:12]], al.; ἐκεῖ, [[luke 12 18|Luk.12:18;]] ποῦ, [[luke 12 17|Luk.12:17;]] συναγαγὼν πάντα (sc. εἰς ἀργύριον; see Field, Notes, 68, MM, xxiv), having sold off all: [[luke 15 13|Luk.15:13;]] of persons, [[john 11 52|Jhn.11:52;]] esp. of assemblies, [[matthew 2 4|Mat.2:4]], [[john 11 47|Jhn.11:47]], [[acts 14 27|Act.14:27]], al. Pass., to be gathered or come together: [[matthew 22 41|Mat.22:41]], [[mark 2 2|Mrk.2:2]], [[luke 22 66|Luk.22:66]], al.; before ἐπί [[mark 5 21|Mrk.5:21]], [[acts 4 27|Act.4:27]]; πρός, [[matthew 13 2|Mat.13:2]], [[mark 4 1|Mrk.4:1]], al.; εἰς, [[revelation 19 17|Rev.19:17;]] ἐν, [[acts 11 26|Act.11:26;]] μετά, [[matthew 28 12|Mat.28:12;]] οὗ, [[matthew 18 20|Mat.18:20;]] ὅπου, [[matthew 26 57|Mat.26:57;]] ἐκεῖ, [[john 18 2|Jhn.18:2]], al. In late writers (see Kennedy, Sources, 128; cf. [[deuteronomy 22 2|Deu.22:2]], al.), to receive hospitably, entertain: [[matthew 25 35|Mat.25:35, 38 25:43]] (cf. ἐπι-συνάγω) (AS)

συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for עֵדָה, also for קָהָל, etc. ;] prop., a bringing together; 1. of things, (a) a gathering in of harvest; (b) a collection of money. 2. Of persons, (a) a collecting, assembling (Polyb.); (b) an assembly (MM, xxiv; Deiss., LAE, 101 ff.): [[revelation 2 9|Rev.2:9 3:9]]; esp. of a Jewish religious assembly, a synagogue: [[luke 12 11|Luk.12:11]], [[acts 9 2|Act.9:2]], al.; of a Christian assembly, [[james 2 2|Jas.2:2.]] By meton., of the building in which the assembly is held, a synagogue: [[matthew 10 17|Mat.10:17]], [[mark 1 21|Mrk.1:21]], al. (cf. Cremer, see word ἐκκλησία) SYN.: ἐκκλησία (which see) (AS)
συν-αγωνίζομαι to strive together with, to help (prop., of sharing in a contest): with dative of person(s) and of thing(s), [[romans 15 30|Rom.15:30.]]† (AS)
συν-αθλέω, -ῶ = συναγωνίζομαι: with dative commod., [[philippians 1 27|Php.1:27;]] with dative of person(s), before ἐν, [[philippians 4 3|Php.4:3.]]† (AS)

συν-αθροίζω [in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;] to gather together, assemble: with accusative of person(s), [[acts 19 25|Act.19:25;]] pass., [[acts 12 12|Act.12:12.]]† ἀθροίζω (ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, VGT, see word; θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;] to Gather, assemble: [[luke 24 33|Luk.24:33.]]† (AS)

συν-αίρω [in LXX: [[exodus 23 5|Exo.23:5]] (עָזַב) * ;] to take up together: σ. λόγον (of which there are several exx. in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 118 f.; MM, i, xxiv; M, Pr., 160), to settle accounts, [[matthew 18 23|Mat.18:23-24;]] before μετά, C. genitive of person(s), [[matthew 25 19|Mat.25:19.]]† (AS)
συν-αιχμάλωτος, -ου, ὁ a fellow prisoner (prop., of a captive in war, see Lft., Col., 234): [[romans 16 7|Rom.16:7]], [[colossians 4 10|Col.4:10]], Phm 23.† (AS)

συν-ακολουθέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 2:6 * ;] to follow along with, accompany: with dative of person(s), [[mark 14 51|Mrk.14:51]], [[luke 23 49|Luk.23:49]]; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), [[mark 5 37|Mrk.5:37.]]† (AS)

συν-αλίζω [in Al.: [[psalms 141 4|Psa.141:4]] * ;] to assemble with: [[acts 1 4|Act.1:4]] (EV, mg., eating with, but on this rendering and on the force of the Pres. ptcp. here, see Field, Notes, 110).† (AS)
συν-ανα-βαίνω [in LXX for עָלָה ;] to go up with: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[mark 15 41|Mrk.15:41]], [[acts 13 31|Act.13:31]].† (AS)

συν-ανά-κειμαι [in LXX: 3Ma.5:39 * ;] to recline with or together at table: [[matthew 14 9|Mat.14:9]], [[mark 6 22|Mrk.6:22]], [[luke 7 49|Luk.7:49 14:15]]; with dative of person(s), [[matthew 9 10|Mat.9:10]], [[mark 2 15|Mrk.2:15]], [[luke 14 10|Luk.14:10]].† (AS)

συν-ανα-μίγνυμι (accusative to Bl., 8, -μείγνυμι), [in LXX: [[hosea 7 8|Hos.7:8]] A ( hithpo.), [[ezekiel 20 18|Eze.20:18]] A * ;] to mix up together; pass., reflex, and metaphorically, to associate with (Plut., Ath., al.): [[1-corinthians 5 9|1Co.5:9 5:11]], [[2-thessalonians 3 14|2Th.3:14]] (see M, Th., 117).† (AS)

συν-ανα-παύομαι [in LXX: [[isaiah 11 6|Isa.11:6]] (רָבַץ) * ;] with dative of person(s), to lie down to rest with, sleep with. Metaphorical, to be refreshed in spirit with: [[romans 15 32|Rom.15:32]] (L, om.).† (AS)

συν-αντάω, -ῶ [in LXX for פָּגַע, פָּגַשׁ, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;] to meet with: with dative of person(s), [[luke 9 18|Luk.9:18, 37 22:10]], [[acts 10 25|Act.10:25]], [[hebrews 7 1|Heb.7:1, 10]]. Metaphorical, of events, to happen, befall (Ding. L., Plut., al.): [[acts 20 22|Act.20:22.]]† (AS)
συν-άντησις, -εως, ἡ Rec. for ὑπάντησις (which see), [[matthew 8 34|Mat.8:34.]]† (AS)

συν-αντι-λαμβάνομαι [in LXX: [[genesis 30 8|Gen.30:8]] R (†), [[exodus 18 22|Exo.18:22]], [[numbers 11 17|Num.11:17]] (נָשָׂא), [[psalms 89 21|Psa.89:21]] (כּוּן ni.) * ;] to take hold with at the side for assistance; hence, to take a share in, help in bearing, and generally, help (with various constructions, see LXX, ll. with, Deiss., LAE, 83 f.): with dative, [[luke 10 40|Luk.10:40]], [[romans 8 26|Rom.8:26]].† (AS)

συν-απ-άγω [in LXX: [[exodus 14 6|Exo.14:6]] (לָקַח) * ;] to lead away with or together (Ex, l.with). Pass., metaphorically (as συμπεριφέρομαι, see LS, see word), to be carried away with: with dative, [[galatians 2 13|Gal.2:13]], [[2-peter 3 17|2Pe.3:17]]; of accommodating one­self to (EV, condescend to) things or persons (on the meaning, see ICC, in I.; Field, Notes, 163), [[romans 12 16|Rom.12:16.]]† (AS)
συν-απο-θνήσκω [in LXX: Sir.19:10 * ;] to die with or together: [[mark 14 31|Mrk.14:31]], [[2-corinthians 7 3|2Co.7:3]] (see Meyer, in l), [[2-timothy 2 11|2Ti.2:11.]]† (AS)
συν-απ-όλλυμι [in LXX chiefly for סָפָה ;] to destroy with or together. Pass., to perish together (with): with dative of person(s), [[hebrews 11 31|Heb.11:31.]]† (AS)
συν-απο-στέλλω [in LXX: [[exodus 33 2|Exo.33:2, 12]] (שָׁלַח), I [[esther 5 2|Est.5:2]] * ;] to send along with: with accusative, [[2-corinthians 12 18|2Co.12:18]] (cf. MM, xxiv).† (AS)

συν-αρμολογέω, -ῶ (ἁρμός, λέγω), = cl. συναρμόζω, to fit or frame together: of the parts of a building, [[ephesians 2 21|Eph.2:21;]] of the members of the body, [[ephesians 4 16|Eph.4:16]] (Eccl.).† (AS)

συν-αρπάζω [in LXX: [[proverbs 6 25|Pro.6:25]] (לָקַח), 2Ma.3:27 2Mac 4:41, 4Ma.5:4 * ;] "perfective " of ἁοπάζω (see M, Pr., 113), (a) to seize and carry away (so most commonly) : [[acts 27 15|Act.27:15;]] (b) to seize and hold: [[luke 8 29|Luk.8:29]], [[acts 6 12|Act.6:12 19:29]].† (AS)
συν-αυξάνω [in LXX: 2Ma.4:4, 4Ma.13:27 * ;] to cause to increase or grow together. Pass., to grow together: [[matthew 13 30|Mat.13:30]] (Xen., al.).† (AS)

σύν-δεσμος, -ου, ὁ (συνδέω), [in LXX for קֶשֶׁר, קְטַר, etc. ;] that which binds together, a bond: of the ligaments of the body, [[colossians 2 19|Col.2:19.]] Metaphorical, σ. ἀδικίας, [[acts 8 23|Act.8:23;]] τ. τελειότητος, [[colossians 3 14|Col.3:14;]] τ. εἰρήνης, [[ephesians 4 3|Eph.4:3]] (see Lft., Col., ll. with).† (AS)
συν-δέω [in LXX for שָׁבַץ, etc. ;] (a) to bind together; (b) to bind together with: pass., [[hebrews 13 3|Heb.13:3.]]† (AS)
συν-δοξάζω 1. to join in approving (Arist.). 2. In NT only, to glorify together: pass., [[romans 8 17|Rom.8:17.]]† (AS)

σύν-δουλος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: [[esther 4 7|Est.4:7, 9 4:17, 23 5:3, 6 6:6, 13]] (כְּנָת) * ;] a fellow-servant: [[matthew 18 28|Mat.18:28-33 24:49]]; of servants of the same divine Lord, [[colossians 1 7|Col.1:7 4:7]], [[revelation 6 11|Rev.6:11]]; so of angels, [[revelation 19 10|Rev.19:10 22:9]].† (AS)
συνδρομή, -ῆς, ἡ (συντρέχω), [in LXX: Jdth.10:18, 3Ma.3:8 * ;] concourse, esp. of a riotous gathering: [[acts 21 30|Act.21:30]] (Arist., Polyb., al.).† (AS)

συν-εγείρω [in LXX: [[exodus 23 5|Exo.23:5]] B2 (עָזַב), [[isaiah 14 9|Isa.14:9]] (עוּר pil.), 4Ma.2:14 * ;] to raise together: metaphorically, of the Christian's mystical resur­rection with Christ, [[ephesians 2 6|Eph.2:6;]] pass., [[colossians 2 12|Col.2:12 3:1]].† (AS)

συνέδριον, -ου, τό (σύν + ἕδρα, a seat) [in LXX: [[proverbs 11 13|Pro.11:13 15:22]], [[jeremiah 15 17|Jer.15:17]] (סוֹד), [[psalms 26 4|Psa.26:4]] (מַת), [[proverbs 22 10|Pro.22:10]] (דִּין) [[proverbs 26 26|Pro.26:26]] (קָהָל); [[proverbs 24 7|Pro.24:7 27:22 31:23]], 2Ma.14:5, 4Ma.17:17 * ;] 1. a council (Plat., Xen., al.; LXX; in π., σ. τ. πρεσβυτέρων, Deiss., BS, 156): of a local Jewish tribunal, [[matthew 10 17|Mat.10:17]], [[mark 13 9|Mrk.13:9]]. 2. The supreme ecclesiastical court of the Jews, the Sanhedrin (i.e. Talmudic סַנְהֵדְרִין = συνέδριον): [[matthew 5 22|Mat.5:22 26:59]], [[mark 14 55|Mrk.14:55 15:1]], [[luke 22 66|Luk.22:66]], [[acts 5 21|Act.5:21, 27 5:34, 41 6:12, 15 22:30 23:1, 6 23:15, 20 23:28]] (WH, R, mg., om.) [[acts 24 20|Act.24:20]] of a meeting of the Sanhedrin, [[john 11 47|Jhn.11:47;]] of the place of meeting, [[acts 4 15|Act.4:15.]]† (AS)

συν-είδησις, -εως, ἡ (συνεῖδον), [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 10 20|Ecc.10:20]] (מַדָּע), Wis.17:11, Sir.42:18 א * ;] 1. consciousness: with genitive obj., [[hebrews 10 2|Heb.10:2]], [[1-peter 2 19|1Pe.2:19]]. 2. In ethical sense, innate discernment, self-judging consciousness, conscience (Stoics and late writers): [[romans 2 15|Rom.2:15 9:1]], [[1-corinthians 10 29|1Co.10:29]], [[2-corinthians 1 12|2Co.1:12 4:2 5:11]], [[1-timothy 4 2|1Ti.4:2]], [[hebrews 9 14|Heb.9:14]]; σ. ἀγαθή, [[acts 23 1|Act.23:1]], [[1-timothy 1 5|1Ti.1:5 1:19]], [[1-peter 3 16|1Pe.3:16 3:21]]; ἀσθενής, [[1-corinthians 8 7|1Co.8:7 8:10]]; ἀσθενοῦσα, [[1-corinthians 8 12|1Co.8:12;]] ἀπρόσκοπος, [[acts 24 16|Act.24:16;]] καθαρά, [[1-timothy 3 9|1Ti.3:9]], [[2-timothy 1 3|2Ti.1:3]]; καλή, [[hebrews 13 18|Heb.13:18;]] πονηρά, [[hebrews 10 22|Heb.10:22;]] ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ σ., [[titus 1 15|Tit.1:15;]] διὰ τὴν σ., [[romans 13 5|Rom.13:5]], [[1-corinthians 10 25|1Co.10:25 10:27-28]]; κατὰ σ., [[hebrews 9 9|Heb.9:9;]] ὑπὸ (τῆς) σ., [[john 8 1|Jhn.8:1-59]] [9] (Rec.), [[1-corinthians 10 29|1Co.10:29]] (cf. Cremer, 233 ff.; ICC on [[romans 2 15|Rom.2:15;]] DB, i, 468 ff.).† (AS)

συν-εῖδον irreg. aorist of συνοράω (see: εἶδον), [in LXX: 1Ma.4:21 א, 2Ma.2:24 2Mac 4:4 2Mac 4:41 R 2Ma.5:17 2Mac 7:4 2Mac 7:20 2Mac 8:8, 3Ma.2:8 A * ;] 1. to see together or at the same time (Arist., Xen.). 2. to see in one view, hence, of mental vision, to comprehend, understand (LXX, Polyb., Plut., al.) : [[acts 12 12|Act.12:12 14:6]] (on the related σύνοιδα, see see word).† (AS)
σύν-ειμι (εἰμί to be), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 3 20|Jer.3:20]] (רֵעַ), al. ;] to be with: [[luke 9 18|Luk.9:18]] (WH, mg., συνήντησαν), [[acts 22 11|Act.22:11.]]† (AS)
σύν-ειμι (εἶμι, to go), to come together: [[luke 8 4|Luk.8:4.]]† (AS)
συν-εισ-έρχομαι [in LXX: [[job 22 4|Job.22:4]] (עִם בּוֹא), etc. ;] to enter together: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[john 6 22|Jhn.6:22 18:15]].† (AS)
συν-έκδημος, -ου, ὁ (ἔκδημος, abroad), a fellow-traveller: [[acts 19 29|Act.19:29]], [[2-corinthians 8 1|2Co.8:1]].† (AS)
συν-εκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν chosen together with, co-elect: ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτή (on the meaning, see ICC, in l), [[1-peter 5 13|1Pe.5:13.]]† (AS)
